name: sfx_serial
description: ScaleFX binary COBS serial protocol — wire primitives (CRC-8, COBS, packet layout, SFX_* macros) in serial/wire.{h,cpp}, diagnostic logging singleton in serial/diag_log.{h,cpp}, client-side framework (SerialBus / BusClient / ResultQueue), generic-expander wire protocol (components/), and HubFX master domain protocol (hubfx/hubfx.h). Server-side framework (BoardServer, BoardServicePolicy, PacketReader, StreamWriter) lives in sfx_server (or sfx_board after Phase 2).
